original.target_description: Single experiment (Study 1): 2 Anchor × 2 Time Pressure ANOVA interaction on probability estimates of an epidemic; main dependent variable on supplied PDF p. 5.

n.sample_role: Students across all four between-participant ANOVA cells
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported; sixty-two enrolled and residual df=58 for four-cell model.
n.quote: Sixty-two students of Leiden University participated

notes: All three assigned rows have identical neutral descriptions and original locators; each receives the same main-dependent-variable interaction printed on PDF p. 5. The separate time-pressure manipulation check F=8.56 tests response latency and is not the probability-estimate outcome. The simple anchor contrast under time pressure t(28)=2.37, p<.05 is on PDF p. 6, and is not substituted for the located interaction. Canonical TXT substitutes D for the equals glyph; numerics verified on rendered primary PDF pp. 5–6.
